title: Job Openings at Union Systems Limited
content:
Union Systems Limited (USL) is an original equipment manufacturer that develops international trade and treasury applications that are used by banks, other financial institutions and corporates.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Head, Project Management Office 

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: the CEO
Work Arrangement: Onsite

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Head of PMO is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the Project Management Office, ensuring the successful delivery of the organization's software development and implementation projects.
	The role provides strategic oversight of the project portfolio, project governance, resource management, delivery standards, and client engagement across all projects.
	The incumbent will lead a team of Project Managers and work closely with Software Development, Quality Assurance, Infrastructure, Support, Product Management, and Business teams to ensure successful delivery of mission-critical software solutions to banks and other financial institutions.
	The role requires strong leadership, business acumen, stakeholder management skills, and extensive experience managing enterprise software development and deployment projects within highly regulated environments.


Ideal Candidate Profile


	A seasoned technology project leader with extensive experience overseeing software development and deployment projects for banks and financial institutions, capable of leading enterprise-wide project portfolios, improving delivery governance, and ensuring successful execution of the company's strategic objectives.


Key Responsibilities
PMO Leadership and Governance:


	Establish and manage the Project Management Office (PMO).
	Develop and enforce project management frameworks, methodologies, policies, standards, and best practices.
	Define project governance models and reporting structures.
	Ensure consistent application of project management principles across all projects.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the PMO.


Project Portfolio Management:


	Oversee the organization's portfolio of software development, implementation, integration, upgrade, and deployment projects.
	Prioritize projects based on strategic business objectives and resource availability.
	Monitor project performance and portfolio health.
	Ensure alignment between project delivery and corporate strategy.
	Provide executive visibility into project status, risks, costs, and resource requirements.


Software Delivery Oversight:


	Oversee the successful delivery of banking and financial software solutions.
	Ensure projects follow established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes.
	Monitor software development, testing, deployment, and implementation activities.
	Ensure timely delivery while maintaining quality and compliance standards.
	Work closely with technical teams to resolve delivery challenges.


Client and Stakeholder Management:


	Build and maintain strategic relationships with banking clients and executive stakeholders.
	Participate in business development discussions and client engagements.
	Manage project escalations and critical client issues.
	Lead executive project reviews, steering committee meetings, and stakeholder forums.
	Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and service delivery excellence.


Resource and Capacity Management:


	Manage project resource planning across the organization.
	Optimize utilization of Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, QA Engineers, and other delivery resources.
	Identify resource gaps and support workforce planning initiatives.
	Collaborate with department heads on staffing requirements.


Financial and Commercial Management:


	Oversee project budgets and financial performance.
	Monitor project profitability and cost control measures.
	Review project estimates, pricing assumptions, and delivery commitments.
	Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions where required.
	Ensure revenue realization through successful project execution.


Risk, Compliance and Quality Management:


	Establish project risk management frameworks.
	Monitor enterprise-level project risks and dependencies.
	Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements applicable to banking and financial institutions.
	Promote quality assurance practices throughout project lifecycles.
	Ensure adherence to information security and data protection standards.


Leadership and People Management:


	Lead, mentor, and develop Project Managers and PMO staff.
	Create a high-performance project management culture.
	Define performance objectives and conduct performance evaluations.
	Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
	Drive leadership development within the PMO team.


Strategic Planning:


	Support executive management in strategic planning and execution.
	Provide insights and recommendations on project investments and delivery capabilities.
	Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiencies.
	Contribute to corporate growth and digital transformation initiatives.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Portfolio project delivery success rate
	Percentage of projects delivered on time and within budget
	Client satisfaction and retention rates
	PMO maturity improvement score
	Project profitability and revenue realization
	Resource utilization efficiency
	Reduction in project risks and escalations
	Successful deployment of banking software solutions
	Employee engagement and PMO team performance.


Qualifications
Education:


	Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	Master's Degree (MBA or related field) is an advantage.


Professional Certifications
Required or highly preferred:


	Project Management Professional (PMP)
	PRINCE2 Practitioner
	PMI Program Management Professional (PgMP) (advantage)
	Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
	PMI-ACP
	Portfolio Management certifications are an added advantage


Experience:


	Minimum of 15 years' experience in project management within technology-driven organizations.
	At least 8 years in a PMO leadership or senior project delivery management role.
	Proven experience managing large-scale software development and deployment projects.
	Demonstrated experience delivering software solutions to banks, financial institutions, or fintech organizations.
	Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and cross-functional teams.
	Strong background in enterprise software implementation and systems integration.


Technical Knowledge:


	Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
	Agile, Scrum, Waterfall and Hybrid methodologies
	Banking Technology Solutions
	Digital Banking Platforms
	Payment Systems
	Core Banking Applications
	Enterprise Integration Projects
	API Development and Integration
	Cloud Technologies (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)
	IT Service Management (ITIL)
	Cybersecurity and Information Security Standards.


Core Competencies
Leadership:


	Strategic Leadership
	Organizational Development
	Executive Presence
	Team Building
	Change Management.


Project & Portfolio Management:


	Portfolio Management
	Program Management
	Budget Management
	Resource Planning
	Governance and Compliance
	Risk Management.


Business Competencies:


	Client Relationship Management
	Commercial Awareness
	Contract Management
	Negotiation Skills
	Business Process Improvement.


Personal Attributes


	Strong analytical capability
	Excellent communication and presentation skills
	Results-driven mindset
	High emotional intelligence
	Strong decision-making ability
	Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.


Application Closing Date: 30th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using "Head, PMO" as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Sales Executive 

Job Location: Victria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking an exceptional and results-driven Sales Executive to lead sales organization and drive aggressive revenue growth across our software solutions portfolio.
	This is not a role for a traditional relationship manager. We are looking for a commercially astute sales leader with a relentless drive to win business, open doors where others see obstacles, and consistently exceed targets.
	The ideal candidate should possess the rare ability to transform prospects into clients, build strategic relationships at executive levels, and close complex enterprise software deals. Simply put, this is someone who could metaphorically "sell ice to an Eskimo."
	The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and executing the company's sales strategy, expanding market share within the banking and financial services sector within and outside Nigeria, managing key client relationships, and building a high-performing sales culture capable of delivering sustainable business growth.


Ideal Candidate Profile


	You are ambitious, persuasive, commercially driven, and energized by closing deals. You thrive in competitive environments, understand how to navigate complex sales cycles, and know how to engage decision-makers at the highest levels.
	You are equally comfortable discussingbusiness strategy with a CEO as you are presenting software solutions to technical stakeholders.
	Most importantly, you have a proven history of turning opportunities into revenue and delivering results where others cannot.


Key Responsibilities
Revenue Generation & Business Growth:


	Develop and execute the company's sales strategy to achieve ambitious revenue and growth targets.
	Drive new business acquisition across banks, financial institutions, fintechs, and other enterprise clients.
	Identify, qualify, pursue, and close high-value software development and implementation opportunities.
	Lead the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and proposal development to contract negotiation and deal closure.
	Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.
	Consistently exceed sales and profitability targets.
	Strategic Account Management
	Develop and nurture relationships with C-Level executives and key decision-makers within client organizations.
	Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling existing solutions.
	Ensure long-term client retention and customer satisfaction.
	Act as a trusted advisor to clients on technology and digital transformation initiatives.


Market Development:


	Identify emerging opportunities, market trends, and competitive threats.
	Develop strategies to increase market penetration and brand visibility.
	Expand the company's presence within the banking and financial services industry.
	Represent the company at industry conferences, networking events, and executive forums.


Sales Leadership: 


	Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing sales team.
	Establish sales processes, performance metrics, and accountability frameworks.
	Drive a culture of excellence, urgency, and results.
	Provide coaching and support to improve team performance and close rates.


Bid and Proposal Management:


	Lead the preparation of compelling proposals, presentations, and commercial offers.
	Collaborate with technical, project, and product teams to develop winning solutions.
	Manage RFPs, RFQs, and tender submissions.
	Ensure proposals effectively address client business needs and demonstrate value.


Executive Reporting:


	Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports to the CEO.
	Monitor key sales metrics and implement corrective actions where necessary.
	Contribute to strategic business planning and corporate growth initiatives.


Requirements
Education:


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
	MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 15 years of experience in B2B sales.
	At least 7 years in a senior sales leadership role.
	Proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets.
	Demonstrable experience selling enterprise software solutions, technology services, or digital transformation solutions.
	Experience selling to banks, financial institutions, Fintechs, or large enterprises is highly preferred.
	Proven ability to close high-value, complex deals.


Required Competencies:


	Sales & Commercial Excellence
	Enterprise Software Sales
	Solution Selling
	Business Development
	Strategic Selling
	Negotiation and Closing
	Pipeline Management
	Proposal Development
	Revenue Forecasting


Leadership: 


	Team Leadership
	Coaching and Mentoring
	Performance Management
	Strategic Thinking
	Decision-Making


Relationship Management:


	Executive Stakeholder Engagement
	Client Relationship Management
	Influencing Skills
	Communication and Presentation Skills
	Networking and Relationship Building


What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:


	Consistently deliver and exceed revenue targets.
	Open new markets and secure strategic accounts.
	Establish strong executive relationships across the banking sector.
	Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
	Increase the company's market share and profitability.
	Create a high-performance sales culture focused on winning.


Application Closing Date: 16th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using "Sales Executive" as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Head, Brand and Communications 

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a resourceful Brand, Content & Communications Executive who can turn complex technology into compelling stories, build executive thought leadership, drive search visibility, manage PR activities, and execute marketing initiatives that support business growth. He or she will manage the marketing department.


What You will Do
Content Strategy & Management:


	Develop blogs, case studies, landing pages, newsletters, presentations, and product content.
	Repurpose content into multiple formats including videos and carousels.
	Ensure messaging is consistent across every touchpoint.


Thought Leadership:


	Build and execute thought leadership initiatives.
	Identify relevant industry conversations and create timely content that positions Union Systems as a leading voice.


Public Relations & Media:


	Develop press releases, media pitches, award submissions, and corporate announcements.
	Manage product launches, events, and demand-generation campaigns
	Monitor media coverage and identify opportunities to increase brand visibility.


SEO, AEO & Digital Visibility:


	Develop and execute SEO and AEO strategies.
	Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences.
	Analytics & Performance
	Track website, content, and campaign performance
	Produce actionable insights and recommendations based on data.
	Continuously test, optimize, and improve marketing performance.


Who We are Looking For


	10 – 15 years of experience in B2B marketing, content marketing, brand communications, or public relations.
	Exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to simplify complex technology topics.
	Proven experience managing content across multiple channels.
	Working knowledge of SEO, AEO, and content optimization
	Experience developing thought leadership content for executives or brands.
	Understanding of PR, media relations, and corporate communications.
	Experience using Marketing automation and reporting tools.
	Strong project management and content planning skills
	Familiarity with AI tools to improve research, writing, and productivity.
	Highly resourceful, proactive, and capable of delivering high-quality work with no supervision.
	Someone with ownership mentality


Bonus Points:


	Experience in fintech, enterprise software, or B2B technology
	Design and video editing skills (Canva, CapCut, Flow etc.)


Application Closing Date: 30th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Supply Chain Specialist",
  "description": "Kerry Group Plc - Founded in 1972 in Co. Kerry, Ireland, the Kerry Group has annualised sales in excess of &euro;7 Billion and supplies over 18,000 food ingredients and flavour products to customers in more than 140 countries worldwide. We have established over 150 manufacturing sites, operate in over 30 countries, and employ 25,000 people worldwide.

Kerry has been present in the Asia-Pacific region since 1997 and has grown its business to become a supplier of choice for our regional and local customers. With over 4,500 employees across the Asia-Pacific, Middle East &amp; Africa (APMEA), Kerry has many exciting opportunities at our many Development &amp; Application Centres, Sales Offices and Manufacturing sites. Spread over 18 countries - and growing - Kerry plays a large role in supplying food &amp; beverage solutions to this diverse region.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Supply Chain Specialist, West Africa&nbsp;

Requisition ID: 66145
Job Location: Lagos

Qualifications and skills


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain, or related field required

  "description": "Hatlab Ice Cream Delite is a hospitality organization that specializes in the production, wholesale and retail of traditional Italian gelato and other complimentary pastries.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Outlet Supervisor&nbsp;

Job Location: Ilorin, Kwara&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Hatlab Ice Cream Delite Limited is looking for an experienced and commercially driven Outlet Supervisorto oversee the operations of our outlets in Ilorin (Palms Mall and Al-Himah University).
	This is a hands-on management role for someone with proven experience supervising an outlet, managing staff, driving sales and taking responsibility for daily business operations.


Key Responsibilities
Outlet Management:


	Take full responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the Ilorin outlets.
	Supervise and coordinate outlet staff and ensure effective allocation of duties.
	Monitor daily sales, customer service, stock, cash handling and general outlet performance.
	Ensure company procedures, hygiene standards and operational standards are consistently maintained.
	Identify operational problems and take appropriate action to resolve them.


Sales &amp; Business Growth:


	Drive daily and monthly sales performance and work towards achieving set targets.
	Analyse sales performance and identify areas requiring improvement.
	Develop and implement practical strategies to increase sales and customer retention.
	Identify new markets and revenue opportunities within Ilorin and surrounding areas.


B2B&nbsp;&nbsp;Business Development:


	Actively identify and pursue B2B sales opportunities.
	Develop relationships with schools, offices, hotels, restaurants, event organisers, retailers and other potential business customers.
	Generate leads, make business contacts, present the company&#39;s products and follow up on opportunities.
	Convert prospects into regular and profitable business accounts.
	Maintain proper records of business development activities and results.


Staff Management:


	Supervise, train and manage outlet staff to ensure productivity and compliance with company standards.
	Monitor attendance, punctuality, performance and conduct.
	Address performance and disciplinary issues appropriately.
	Maintain a professional and productive working environment.


Stock &amp; Cash Control:


	Ensure proper monitoring and control of inventory.
	Ensure timely replenishment and prevent unnecessary stock-outs.
	Monitor stock movement, conduct stock checks and investigate discrepancies.
	Ensure accurate daily sales and cash/POS reconciliation.
	Take appropriate measures to minimise wastage, losses and revenue leakages.


Customer Service:


	Ensure a consistently high standard of customer service.
	Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
	Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities for service improvement.


Reporting:


	Prepare and submit regular reports on sales, stock, staff performance and outlet operations.
	Provide Management with timely updates on challenges, opportunities and actions taken.
	Track and report on B2B leads, prospects, conversions and business generated.


Requirements


	Minimum of 2years of proven experience in outlet management, retail, hospitality, food service, restaurant, caf&eacute;, QSR, supermarket or a similar customer-facing business.
	Proven experience supervising and managing staff.
	Demonstrable experience in driving sales and achieving business targets.
	Experience in stock and cash control.
	Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
	Strong communication and reporting skills.
	Ability to work independently and take ownership of outlet performance.
	Must have practical experience in business development, sales prospecting or B2B sales.
	Must be commercially minded and results-oriented.
	Must be willing to work across the company&#39;s Ilorin outlets.


Important:


	We are looking for someone with actual supervisory/management experience and a proven ability to take responsibility for business operations.


Salary
N120,000 - N150,000monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: admin@hatlabgelato.com using &quot;Application for Outlet Supervisor&ndash; Ilorin&quot; as the subject of the mail.

  "title": "Stock Holding Officer",
  "description": "Ignite Energy Access is an Abu Dhabi-based leader in distributed renewable energy solutions, dedicated to providing affordable, reliable, and sustainable electricity to underserved communities across Africa. Now operating across 12 countries and serving over 15million people. Through innovative technology, scalable business models, and impact-driven financing, Ignite Power is transforming lives, fostering economic growth, and driving the continent&rsquo;s clean energy transition.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Stock Holding Officer&nbsp;

Job Location: Alimosho and Ikorodu - Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Job Description
Job Purpose / Mission:


	The Customer Experience Unit is looking for a bright, highly motivated and disciplined Stock Holding Officerwith a passion for entrepreneurship, renewable energy, and financial inclusion
